projects.title: Beyond OS
projects.description: • Designed and developed a centralized Business Operating System to streamline internal organizational operations. The platform unifies CRM, HRMS, project management, approvals, employee management, reporting, and administrative workflows into a single enterprise application with a configurable and scalable architecture.
projects.problem:
• 1. Business operations were spread across multiple disconnected tools and spreadsheets.
      • 2. Manual approvals and repetitive administrative tasks reduced productivity.
      • 3. Limited visibility into teams, projects, and operational performance.
      • 4. Scaling the application for multiple organizations required repeated customization.
projects.keyDecisions:
• 1. Adopted a modular architecture to allow independent business modules.
  • 2. Implemented Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for granular user permissions.
  • 3. Built configurable workflows, approval systems, and organization settings.
  • 4. Designed an API-first architecture to support web, mobile, and third-party integrations.
  • 5. Developed reusable components and centralized configurations to simplify maintenance and future expansion.
projects.outcome:
• 1. Consolidated multiple business functions into a single platform.
  • 2. Reduced operational overhead through workflow automation and centralized management.
  • 3. Improved scalability by enabling rapid onboarding of new organizations with minimal configuration.
  • 4. Established a reusable enterprise platform capable of supporting future modules such as AI assistants, analytics, and advanced automation.

projects.title: Beyond C
projects.description: Beyond C is a creator marketplace and campaign management platform designed to solve fragmented influencer marketing workflows. It centralizes creator discovery, communication, campaign tracking, and analytics, enabling brands, creators, and agencies to collaborate more efficiently and achieve better campaign outcomes.
projects.problem:
1. 1. Brands struggled to discover creators that matched their target audience and campaign goals.
    2. 2. Campaign communication was scattered across WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, and social media DMs.
    3. 3. Managing campaigns manually led to missed deadlines, poor coordination, and limited visibility.
    4. 4. Small creators found it difficult to gain exposure and secure brand collaborations.
    5. 5. Agencies had no centralized workspace to manage multiple clients, creators, and campaigns.
    6. 6. There was no transparent way to measure campaign performance or creator effectiveness.
    7. 7. Brands lacked a single platform to manage the complete influencer marketing lifecycle
projects.keyDecisions:
• 1. Built an all in one SaaS platform connecting brands, creators, and agencies in a unified ecosystem.
  • 2. Designed dedicated dashboards and workflows for each user role to simplify operations.
  • 3. Implemented advanced creator discovery using categories, audience insights, and performance metrics.
  • 4. Integrated real time messaging, campaign management, and collaboration into a single platform.
  • 5. Added campaign milestones, digital agreements, and analytics to improve transparency and accountability.
  • 6. Focused on scalable architecture to support future AI powered recommendations and automation.
  • 7. Prioritized an intuitive user experience to reduce onboarding time and increase adoption
projects.outcome:
• Centralized campaign management into a single platform, eliminating the need for multiple tools.
  • Improved collaboration and communication between brands, creators, and agencies.
  • Reduced manual effort and administrative overhead through streamlined workflow.
  • Enabled faster creator discovery and more relevant partnership opportunities.
  • Increased campaign transparency with real time tracking, milestones, and performance analytics.
  • Created a scalable foundation for AI driven campaign recommendations and workflow automation.
  • Delivered a more efficient, data driven influencer marketing experience for all stakeholders.

projects.title: Linkedin Automator
projects.description: An AI-powered platform that automates LinkedIn content creation, scheduling, and publishing while helping individuals and businesses maintain a consistent online presence with minimal manual effort.
projects.problem:
• Maintaining a consistent LinkedIn presence is time-consuming.
  • Users struggle to come up with engaging post ideas regularly.
  • Creating high-quality content requires significant writing effort.
  • Managing multiple LinkedIn accounts manually is inefficient.
  • Businesses lack analytics to understand what content performs best.
  • Scheduling posts across different time zones is cumbersome.
  • Teams have no centralized workflow for content planning and approvals.
projects.keyDecisions:
• Integrated AI to generate high-quality LinkedIn posts from simple prompts.
  • Built a content calendar with automated scheduling and publishing.
  • Added post templates and tone customization for different audiences.
  • Implemented analytics to measure engagement and optimize future content.
  • Designed a centralized dashboard for managing multiple LinkedIn accounts.
  • Enabled collaboration features for teams to review and approve content.
  • Focused on reducing manual effort while maintaining authentic content quality.
projects.outcome:
• 1. Reduced the time required to create and publish LinkedIn content.
  • 2. Improved posting consistency and audience engagement.
  • 3. Simplified content planning through an intuitive scheduling workflow.
  • 4. Enabled businesses to scale personal branding across multiple profiles.
  • 5. Increased productivity by automating repetitive content management tasks.
  • 6. Provided actionable insights through performance analytics.
  • 7. Created a scalable solution for individuals, agencies, and marketing teams.

projects.title: Email Automation Platform
projects.description: An AI-powered email automation platform that helps businesses generate personalized emails, automate follow-ups, and manage outreach campaigns to improve lead generation and customer engagement.
projects.problem:
• Sales teams spend excessive time writing repetitive emails.
  • Manual follow-ups lead to missed opportunities and inconsistent communication.
  • Personalizing outreach at scale is difficult.
  • Businesses lack visibility into email campaign performance.
  • Managing large outreach campaigns manually reduces productivity.
  • Inconsistent messaging affects brand communication.
  • Tracking conversations across prospects is fragmented.
projects.keyDecisions:
• 1. Leveraged AI to generate personalized email content based on recipient context.
  • 2. Built automated email sequences with customizable follow-up workflows.
  • 3. Added campaign management with scheduling and recipient segmentation.
  • 4. Integrated analytics for open rates, reply rates, and campaign performance.
  • 5. Designed reusable email templates to ensure consistent communication.
  • 6. Implemented centralized contact and campaign management.
  • 7. Focused on scalability to support high-volume outreach campaigns.
projects.outcome:
• 1. Significantly reduced the time spent on email outreach.
  • 2. Improved response rates through personalized AI-generated emails.
  • 3. Increased lead engagement with automated follow-up sequences.
  • 4. Streamlined campaign management from a single platform.
  • 5. Enhanced visibility through detailed campaign analytics.
  • 6. Improved team productivity by eliminating repetitive manual tasks.
  • 7. Enabled businesses to execute scalable and data-driven outreach campaigns.

cta.heading: Hiring a product-minded builder?
cta.description: I'd rather chat than send another cold DM. Book a call, drop an email, or just say hi.

bio: I'm Vaibhav — senior software engineer with 3+ years of full-stack experience across the .NET and JavaScript worlds. I've spent most of that time in the enterprise trenches, shipping React and Next.js frontends onto .NET Core and Azure backends, and picking up MERN/MEAN work along the way.

Somewhere in the last 18 months, my curiosity outgrew the ticket queue. I started building AI tools for myself on nights and weekends — four of them, so far — and each one taught me that the hard part was never the code. It was scoping, sequencing, and knowing what not to build.

That's the muscle I want to grow next. I'm spending more time where the code meets the user — not because engineering bored me, but because the most interesting decisions in AI products live one layer up: what to build, for whom, with what tradeoffs, at what pace. That's the room I'm earning a seat in.

timeline.title: Started as a .NET engineer
timeline.description: Joined the enterprise trenches — .NET Core, Azure, MERN/MEAN. Learned that shipping is a team sport and that most production bugs live in the seams between systems, not the systems themselves.

timeline.title: Went full-stack + cloud
timeline.description: Owned end-to-end features across React, Next.js, and Azure. Got the Cloud Computing Architecture cert. Started asking 'why are we building this?' more often than 'how do we build this?'.

timeline.title: The AI switch flipped
timeline.description: Fell hard for the modern AI stack — Claude Code, n8n, ComfyUI, Ollama, ElevenLabs. Realized my engineering superpower isn't code, it's shipping the thing end-to-end while everyone else prototypes.

timeline.title: Built 4 AI tools solo
timeline.description: LinkedIn Automator, Idea Curator, Leads Finder, Agentic Workflow Summarizer — all self-initiated, all documented as case studies. Earned the PM certification along the way.

timeline.title: Betting on product-led engineering
timeline.description: Widening my lane from 'how to build' to 'what to build, for whom, and why now' — where engineering context, AI intuition, and product judgment overlap. It's where the interesting decisions get made.
